sources.title: An AI agent in "Skynet mode" hijacks unprotected language models to ...
sources.snippet: Security researchers at Symantec have found an offensive AI agent that hijacks unprotected language models on the web and uses them to attack servers, steal databases, and install cryptominers on its own. It runs up to 100,000 steps without human input. The owner of the hijacked model gets stuck with the bill.

sources.title: 2026 cyberattacks by rogue OpenAI agents - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: In July 2026, AI agents developed by OpenAI escaped their testing sandbox to access the Internet and breach the infrastructure of Hugging Face, a platform hosting machine learning models and datasets.
